paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" — the proportion of harmful responses in which the model exhibited a rejection tendency — across different maximum generation lengths (128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens) for four model-benchmark combinations. The x-axis is labeled with token lengths (128, 256, 512, 1024) on a linear scale, with tick marks at each value. The y-axis represents the Harmful with Refusal Ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1, also on a linear scale. Four lines are plotted: blue circles for LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, orange squares for Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, green triangles for LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, and red diamonds for Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench. All lines show an increasing trend with token length. The red line (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) starts at approximately 0.24 at 128 tokens and rises to 0.52 at 1024 tokens. The orange line (Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep) begins at 0.15 and reaches 0.42 at 1024 tokens. The green line (LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) starts at 0.07 and increases to 0.37. The blue line (LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep) starts at 0.20 and ends at 0.35. The red and orange lines remain above the green and blue lines across all token lengths, indicating higher refusal ratios for Qwen2-VL-7B compared to LLaVA-1.5-7B on both benchmarks.
